capabilities: Expose a localhost REST API for note CRUD via Obsidian's Vault API
Resolve wiki and markdown links to real vault paths through the metadata cache
Serve and upload vault files as binary assets over HTTP
List journal entries using the vault's daily-notes folder and format
Provide a built-in browser UI for browsing and editing daily notes
disambiguation: Not a web clipper or browser extension; it serves your existing vault to a browser or HTTP client rather than capturing web pages.
extras: Desktop only. Fresh installs start with a shared default API key (addwxfengshu4511) so clients connect out of the box; the README warns users to regenerate it if they see that as a risk. The optional Allow LAN setting binds 0.0.0.0 for phones and tablets. A Chinese-language section repeats the summary; full API details are only in the English part.
intentEvidence: an Infinity-style journal page (evolved from the Note Tab Chrome extension) served by the plugin itself; no extension install needed
problem: Vault notes are only accessible inside Obsidian, so external tools, scripts and other devices cannot read, edit or fetch notes and assets over a network.

relations.evidence: an Infinity-style journal page (evolved from the Note Tab Chrome extension)

summary: Localhost HTTP API (API-key protected) for viewing, creating, editing and deleting vault notes, resolving wiki links and serving assets, with a built-in browser journal UI.
